password.requirements: The password must be at least {{count}} characters, one uppercase letter and one number

connect.wrongPassword: Your BGG password is incorrect. It's the same one you use to sign in to boardgamegeek.com (not your {{brandName}} password). Double-check it and try again.
connect.unavailable: BGG didn't respond: it may be down or slow. It's not a problem with your password — wait a moment and try again.
connect.network: Couldn't connect to BGG. Check your internet connection and try again.
connect.generic: Couldn't connect to BGG. Try again in a moment.

sync.notFound: We couldn't find that user on BGG. Check that your BGG username in your profile is spelled correctly.
sync.failed: BGG didn't respond or failed midway through the sync. Whatever was already synced is kept — wait a moment and try again.
sync.network: Couldn't sync with BGG. Check your internet connection and try again.
sync.generic: Couldn't sync with BGG. Try again in a moment.
